Sarah Orne Jewett, The Country of the Pointed Firs.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/sarah-orne-jewett/the-country-of-the-pointed-firs

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Sarah Orne Jewett, the author, died 1909 (Wikidata Q444995; death 1909-06-24 in the facts file, with a second date of 1909-12-24).

First publication of the text used: 1896 (SE colophon: 'The Country of the Pointed Firs was published in 1896 by Sarah Orne Jewett')

Why this is public domain:

- Country of origin (not needed for this decision): every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (see the list above), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
